cargo install.how: names a way a workflow may install weaver, in prose; not an invocation to run

gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/branches/<br.how: Against a repo with classic protection: lists its required checks; against a ruleset-only repo: 404

gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/rules/branch.how: Against a repo with rulesets: lists its rules (required checks, code_scanning); against one without: []

gh search code \"<owner>/<repo>/.github/.how: For a repo whose local setup action another repo uses: finds that other repo's workflow

make check-policies.how: an earlier setup's target, named in the renames table; not one to run

make generate.how: the codegen part's target, named in prose

make package.how: the release part's target, named in prose

make validate-registry.how: the registry part's target, named in prose

weaver registry check.how: names a tool or subcommand in prose; not an invocation to run

weaver registry update-markdown.how: names the subcommand a repo refreshes hand-written docs pages with, in prose; listed by weaver 0.28.0's registry --help
